_doc: One look per Emberveil class, built by tools/build-emberveil-classes.mjs from the art direction. Keys are class ids; each has the full avatar (2D/3D), voice and speech sections of the shared character JSON.

warrior.name: Brannoc Redmane
warrior.hook: Shield Bash stuns enemies. Whirlwind hits all adjacent foes. Unbreakable when outnumbered.

custom.catchphrase: {~Stay down.|Next.|Is that all?|Come on, then.|I said stay down.}

fighter.name: Corvin Hale
fighter.hook: Riposte counters parries. Tactical stances swap between offense and defense. Precise Strike never misses.

custom.catchphrase: {~Form over fury.|Watch the feet.|Again. Properly this time.|Discipline wins.|Measure twice, cut once.}

paladin.name: Aurel Dawnward
paladin.hook: Holy Strike crits vs demons. Lay on Hands keeps allies alive. Consecration sustains long fights.

custom.catchphrase: {~The Light holds.|Stand in the Light.|Not while I stand.|Mercy later.|By the Light, enough.}

ranger.name: Wren Ashvale
ranger.hook: Aimed Shot ignores armor. Rain of Arrows blankets the entire enemy field for 3 rounds.

custom.catchphrase: {~One arrow, one answer.|Quiet now.|Wind's wrong. Wait.|Mark it. Loose.|The trail knows.}

rogue.name: Sable Quick
rogue.hook: 200% Backstab on stunned targets. Death Mark makes enemies take 50% more damage from all sources.

custom.catchphrase: {~Didn't see me. Nobody does.|Blink and it's done.|That was the easy part.|Pockets. Always the pockets.|Quiet feet, quick hands.}

cleric.name: Mirelle Sanct
cleric.hook: Mass Resurrection can auto-trigger on wipe. Sanctuary makes an ally temporarily untargetable.

custom.catchphrase: {~Breathe. I have you.|The Light mends.|Hold still, hero.|Not today. Not on my watch.|Wounds close. Grudges don't.}

bard.name: Tamsin Lark
bard.hook: Ballad of Valor gives one hero two turns per round. Song of Ruin strips all enemy buffs at once.

custom.catchphrase: {~Somebody write that down!|And the crowd goes wild.|A verse for that later.|Tragic. Marvellous.|Encore, encore.}

mage.name: Edric Vane
mage.hook: Fireball torches entire enemy packs. Blizzard hits all enemies for 3 rounds. Arcane Surge: 400% INT.

custom.catchphrase: {~As the theory predicts.|Stand clear.|Elegant, no?|Knowledge is a weapon.|Observe.}

necromancer.name: Osric Mourne
necromancer.hook: Raise Dead turns corpses into skeleton allies. Death Coil applies Poison AND Bleed to all enemies.

custom.catchphrase: {~The dead have opinions.|Rest is optional.|Waste not.|Quiet, all of you.|I could use that body.}

warlock.name: Vesna Duskwell
warlock.hook: Corruption spreads on enemy death. Soul Pact doubles all DoT at cost of own HP.

custom.catchphrase: {~Everything has a price.|The pact holds.|Louder, please, I want it to hear.|Bargain struck.|You feel that? Good.}

demon_hunter.name: Kael Sorrowend
demon_hunter.hook: +50% damage vs demons. Vengeance stacks from fallen allies then unleashes devastating burst.

custom.catchphrase: {~I smell brimstone.|Send more.|Hell owes me.|Marked. Finished.|Burn it out.}

scavenger.name: Grit Pennyworth
scavenger.hook: Lucky Strike inflicts random statuses. Big Score is a high-variance gambling strike — crit huge or whiff.

custom.catchphrase: {~Is that worth anything?|Waste of good boots.|Mine now.|Everything's scrap eventually.|Don't throw that away.}

swashbuckler.name: Lucan Farrow
swashbuckler.hook: Build Flair stacks with Flourish. Grandeur releases all stacks in one legendary strike.

custom.catchphrase: {~Ha! Did you see that?|Elegance, darling.|Was that all?|Hold my hat.|I make it look easy because it is.}

dragon_knight.name: Sera Emberscale
dragon_knight.hook: Choose fire/ice/lightning. Draconic Fury turns all attacks into group AoE for 2 rounds.

custom.catchphrase: {~Scale and fire.|The old blood wakes.|Kneel.|I have burned worse.|Roar with me.}

pyromancer.name: Ilsa Cinder
pyromancer.hook: Stack Burn on multiple groups. Meteor ignites every enemy group simultaneously.

custom.catchphrase: {~Warmer.|Everything burns.|Stand back, friends.|Ash and ember.|Feel that? That's mine.}

stormcaller.name: Torvald Gale
stormcaller.hook: Chain Lightning jumps between enemies. Thunder Ring zones the battlefield.

custom.catchphrase: {~Hear the thunder?|Lightning picks its own.|Static. Good.|Skies with me.|Crackle.}

druid.name: Aveline Thorne
druid.hook: Rejuvenation HoTs. Wild Shape for raw damage. Nature’s Wrath in the late game.

custom.catchphrase: {~The wild answers.|Roots and thorns.|Grow. Now.|Nature keeps score.|Hush. Listen.}

oracle.name: Nysa Farsight
oracle.hook: Foresight pre-shields allies against incoming damage. Prophecy reveals enemy intents.

custom.catchphrase: {~I saw this.|Fate turns.|Not yet. Soon.|The thread holds.|You were always going to say that.}

tactician.name: Marcus Ostwald
tactician.hook: Grants extra actions, repositions allies, reshuffles enemy turn order.

custom.catchphrase: {~As planned.|Hold the line.|Positions.|Predictable.|Adapt.}

chronomancer.name: Benedict Hourne
chronomancer.hook: Haste allies, slow enemies, rewind HP, freeze the battlefield in Time Stop.

custom.catchphrase: {~Tick. Tock.|Time is a suggestion.|We have a moment. I made it.|Again, from the top.|Later. Or earlier.}

monk.name: Jiro Stillwater
monk.hook: Unarmed flurries stack chi. Inner Focus self-heals. Shadow Step dashes into crit range.

custom.catchphrase: {~Breathe.|The body knows.|Still water.|Strike. Release.|Enough.}

shaman.name: Zuri Bonechant
shaman.hook: Totems heal over time. Spirit bolts chain to nearby foes. Ancestral Shield wards the party.

custom.catchphrase: {~The spirits watch.|Ancestors, guide the hand.|Old ways, old power.|The bones say yes.|Wind and bone.}

witch_hunter.name: Solomon Kreel
witch_hunter.hook: Silver bolts purge curses. Bonus damage vs demons and undead. Marks targets for the party.

custom.catchphrase: {~Purge it.|Silver settles it.|No mercy for the marked.|Confess.|The hunt ends here.}

knight.name: Isolde Vaunt
knight.hook: Shield Bash stuns, Taunt locks aggro, Holy Strike sears evil, Rally bolsters the party.

custom.catchphrase: {~For the oath.|Shield up.|Hold fast.|Honour before comfort.|I stand.}

sorcerer.name: Cassius Vell
sorcerer.hook: Wild Bolt rolls a random element. Arcane Surge doubles spell power. Mana Burn punishes casters.

custom.catchphrase: {~Chaos, kindly.|Ooh, that was new.|Power is a mood.|Let's see what this does.|Marvellous mess.}

runesmith.name: Dagan Forgehand
runesmith.hook: Rune Hammer hits with imbued force. Wards protect allies. Forge Flame ignites weapons.

custom.catchphrase: {~Forge-marked.|Iron holds.|Struck true.|Runes don't lie.|Hammer says no.}

shadow_dancer.name: Nyx Veilstep
shadow_dancer.hook: Smoke Veil grants evasion. Assassinate executes low-HP foes. Dance of Blades chains strikes.

custom.catchphrase: {~Shadow, take me.|Gone.|Last dance.|Quiet as ash.|You never heard me.}

tinker.name: Fenwick Cogsby
tinker.hook: Clockwork bolts, alchemical grenades, and a pocket-watch that patches wounds mid-fight. Overcharge the whole party with an arcane spring-wound battery.

custom.catchphrase: {~Cogs and gears!|One more adjustment.|Springs wound, bolts loaded.|That should hold. Should.|Science, mostly.}

priest.name: Selene Duskmoon
priest.hook: Heals the living, calls back the fallen, and answers their killers with shadow. The party's reviver and second-line damage dealer.

custom.catchphrase: {~Light and shadow both.|Come back to us.|Rest is not the end.|Shadow answers.|Be still.}

enchanter.name: Auren Whisperlight
enchanter.hook: Lulls foes to sleep so the party can pick its fights. Drowse opens packs without alerting them. Arcane Jolt wakes targets only when you decide they should die.

custom.catchphrase: {~Sleep now.|Mind over might.|Hush, and dream.|A thought, placed just so.|Wake when I say.}
